description: Calendar partition, selection, screening and monitoring rules of the article pipeline.
decision_time: actual landing of the upstream flight, local civil time
successor_order: actual departure order of the same aircraft; scheduled order is a sensitivity analysis
outcome_rule: a record enters a fitting, selection or screening period only when its onward departure occurred before the period ended
epoch_rule: keep the epoch with the highest mean April share of qualifying delay minutes among the top 10%, 15% and 20% of retrieval scores

selection.criterion: maximise qualifying delay minutes subject to the selection upper limit; ties go to fewer false alerts, then to enumeration order
selection.frontier: candidates with selection upper limit at most 24%, ordered by upper limit and kept only when delay minutes strictly increase

screening.rule: fixed-sequence test along the frontier: screen candidates in order and stop at the first screening limit above the budget
screening.ceiling_rule: a budget point is admitted under a ceiling when its joint limit and its one-, three- and five-day block percentiles all lie within the ceiling; the admitted point with the most selection delay minutes is used

monitoring.checked_alerts: alerts of the current month issued by the current policy whose onward flights departed before the check
monitoring.pause_rule: model alerts pause when the corrected upper limit exceeds the ceiling; the timing rule keeps running
monitoring.replacement: select on days 30 to 16 before the check and screen on days 15 to 1 before the check with the ceiling rule
monitoring.approval: model alerts resume after the carrier operations lead approves the screened replacement

resampling.statistic: sum minutes within each replicate before forming shares

period_format: month-day within one operating year; intervals include the first day and exclude the last day, and the closed-loop replay includes 31 December
